question: ¿Cuáles son las 5 concesiones con más posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024, contando los puntos que caen dentro del contorno de cada concesión?

attempts.query: WITH c AS (SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rid, id_concesion, areapermisoconcesion, anillo::jsonb AS ring FROM sig_energia.concesion WHERE anillo IS NOT NULL AND anillo <> ''), v AS (SELECT c.rid, c.areapermisoconcesion, e.i, (e.p->>0)::float8 AS x, (e.p->>1)::float8 AS y FROM c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.ring) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(p, i) WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.p) = 'array'), edges AS (SELECT rid, areapermisoconcesion, x AS x1, y AS y1, COALESCE(lead(x) OVER w, first_value(x) OVER w) AS x2, COALESCE(lead(y) OVER w, first_value(y) OVER w) AS y2 FROM v WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY rid ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)), bbox AS (SELECT rid, areapermisoconcesion, min(x) AS minx, max(x) AS maxx, min(y) AS miny, max(y) AS maxy FROM v GROUP BY rid, areapermisoconcesion), pts AS (SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND lon IS NOT NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL), cand AS (SELECT b.rid, b.areapermisoconcesion, p.gml_id, p.lon, p.lat FROM bbox b JOIN pts p ON p.lon BETWEEN b.minx AND b.maxx AND p.lat BETWEEN b.miny AND b.maxy), inside AS (SELECT cand.rid, cand.areapermisoconcesion, cand.gml_id FROM cand JOIN edges e ON e.rid = cand.rid WHERE ((e.y1 > cand.lat) <> (e.y2 > cand.lat)) AND cand.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (cand.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1 GROUP BY cand.rid, cand.areapermisoconcesion, cand.gml_id HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1) SELECT areapermisoconcesion FROM inside GROUP BY rid, areapermisoconcesion ORDER BY count(DISTINCT gml_id) DESC LIMIT 5
